FIELD MANUAL / 01

Turn instinct into firepower.

A D / ← →Move

Keep firing on the move to break through.

K / SpaceDouble jump

Press again in midair to cross broken bridges.

↓ / S (hold)Crouch

Hold on the ground to duck and fire under incoming shots. Release to stand, or press K / Space to jump.

J / Left clickContinuous fire

Hold to fire. Aim with the mouse; W / ↑ aims up, S / ↓ aims down in midair.

Shift / HTactical dash

Briefly invulnerable. Dash through fire; 1.2-second cooldown.

L / Right clickThrow a grenade

Area damage. Checkpoints replenish your supply.

QSwitch weapon

Collect S for Swarm Shot and R for the Arc Railgun.

FIELD TIPSOrange means enemy fire. Watch for marked impact zones and boss charges. Jump over shockwaves; dash through volleys. Green beacons save progress and restore armor.
